_README: E4 of the blockquote protocol. Keys are passage_id values from passages.tsv (e.g. 'v24-048-p02'); values are the real person's name, written BY A HUMAN after reading the attribution_lead and footnote_text columns. Any key starting with '_' is ignored. A passage listed here is promoted to speaker_confidence=certain and becomes shippable. A quotation NOT listed here and not carrying an inline attribution ships with speaker='' and is dropped by web/src/jardine.ts normalize() — never guessed, never attributed to the volume author.
_example: "v24-048-p02": "William Hewitson"  (lead-in reads: 'Mr Hewitson relates his knowledge of one which'; footnote 68 reads: 'Oology, i.')
_nested: A passage at blockquote depth >= 2 (a quote inside a quote) is NEVER resolved automatically: the enclosing span's inline/footnote/lead-in evidence names the OUTER speaker, so applying it would manufacture a confident wrong name. Those 9 passages carry speaker_source='nested_quotation' and can only be named here, by a human, from the source page.
_status: EMPTY, and re-counted after the F1 blockquote-depth fix of 2026-07-27 (which reclassified 23 passages from Jardine's own prose to quotations). 332 quotations total: 3 ship (all resolved by footnote+lead_in concordance), 149 probable and 180 unresolved await the human afternoon. 9 of the 180 are nested — see _nested.
